entities.summary: Meaux Cathedral is a Roman Catholic church in the town of Meaux, Seine-et-Marne, France, and a cathedral as the seat of the Bishop of Meaux. It is a historical monument of France. Meaux Cathedral is a minor basilica in Europe, established in 1175. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
